needed.evidence: No footway on the right side of the road, people are forced onto the carriageway.
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous physical barrier sidewalk of at least 1-metre width along the right side to provide a safe pedestrian space.

needed.evidence: Obstructions on the partially usable sidewalk on the left side.
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and maintain a clear and continuous 1-metre informal path or improve to a proper sidewalk.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections and obstructions causing trip hazards on the footway.
needed.suggestion: Repair and smoothen the hazardous sections of the footway to eliminate tripping risks.

needed.evidence: People seen crossing on the right side with no purpose-built crossing.
needed.suggestion: Implement a clearly marked pedestrian crossing with high-visibility markings and a refuge island in the middle of the road.

needed.evidence: Marked zebra crossing obstructed by fencing and little indication for drivers to stop.
needed.suggestion: Add traffic signals and improve crossing visibility by installing audible signals and better lighting at the crossing.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs at the pedestrian crossing, making it difficult for people with disabilities.
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the pedestrian crossing to ensure accessibility for all users, including those with wheelchairs and mobility aids.
